verdict.rationale: Babylon.js has strong, dedicated glTF import support (docs-6) plus OBJ/STL/.babylon formats and exporter plugins for Blender/Maya/3ds Max (docs-31, docs-33), and community feedback confirms glTF/Blender workflows 'just work' (comm-9). However, there is no evidence of native FBX or USD import — the exporters listed only push data out of DCC tools into Babylon-friendly formats, not direct FBX/USD ingestion, so the story's broader interchange-format promise is only partially met. Missing for 10: documented FBX import path, documented USD import path, independent verification of import fidelity across all three formats.
